end.summary:
Mahi named north, south, east, and west.
They recalled that the sun rises in the east.
They mixed up a magnet’s north-seeking end with geographic north and cold weather.
The lesson ended before teach-back was passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the four directions and introduced how a magnet helps find north. Mahi recalled east as the direction of sunrise. They mixed up the magnet’s north-seeking end with the coldness of the northern region; this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, use a compass or magnet and mark north, south, east, and west together.
